items.t: Vistra Has Slumped for a Year: Why Morgan Stanley Still Sees 82% Upside
items.sum: Key TakeawaysMorgan Stanley cut its Vistra price target to $211 from $224 and kept its Overweight rating, which still points to 82% upside. Vistra fell on cheaper Texas power and an election that put data center growth in doubt, and Constellation Energy and NRG Energy are down sharply too, even though both held or raised guidance.

items.t: Is Vistra (VST) Still Below Fair Value After Data Center Clarity?
items.sum: Vistra has delivered very large gains over the past five years, yet its recent pullback leaves a live question about whether the current share price lines up with the earnings power of the business. With the stock now trading around US$123.87 and sentiment shaped by the power market debate, the issue is what that figure says about the relationship between Vistra's profit stream and its valuation.
